title: MORI IO traffic
description: Traffic of the MORI IO engines (mori_io_*): throughput, latency and failures of the transfers, which GPU sends to which, and what the RDMA backend puts on each NIC. Every transfer is counted once, in the process that started it.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.description: Throughput, latency and failures: the engines running on these hosts. Sent / Received per GPU and per NIC, and the matrix: the GPUs and NICs of these hosts, whichever engine started the transfer.

list.name: mhost
list.label: Host with traffic between its GPUs

query.query: query_result(count by (src_host) (last_over_time(mori_io_submitted_bytes_total{src_host=~"$host",backend=~"$backend"}[$__range]) and on (src_host, dst_host) label_replace(count by (src_host) (last_over_time(mori_io_submitted_bytes_total{src_host=~"$host",backend=~"$backend"}[$__range])), "dst_host", "$1", "src_host", "(.+)")))

list.definition: query_result(count by (src_host) (last_over_time(mori_io_submitted_bytes_total{src_host=~"$host",backend=~"$backend"}[$__range]) and on (src_host, dst_host) label_replace(count by (src_host) (last_over_time(mori_io_submitted_bytes_total{src_host=~"$host",backend=~"$backend"}[$__range])), "dst_host", "$1", "src_host", "(.+)")))

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window of the tiles and of the GPU to GPU matrices. The charts over time follow the dashboard's own resolution. 5s and 10s are for the millisecond data source: scraped data has a point every few seconds.

panels.title: XGMI sent per GPU
panels.description: Bytes per second one GPU sends over XGMI, to all its peers together: the average over the GPUs of the selected hosts that send over XGMI, and over the window. (One XGMI link carries about 49 GB/s one way on MI300X; a GPU that sends to several peers adds them up.)

panels.title: RDMA sent per NIC
panels.description: Bytes per second one NIC sends for the RDMA backend: the average over the NICs of the selected hosts that send, and over the window. Hold it against the link speed (the dashed line in the NIC charts).

panels.title: Not successful
panels.description: Transfers per second that ended failed, or unobserved (the status object was destroyed or reused before anything saw the transfer finish). Red when not zero.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Transfers submitted and not yet seen in a terminal state, now.

panels.title: Latency, 99th percentile
panels.description: 99 % of the transfers took less than this, over the window. Estimated from histogram buckets (1, 2.5, 5 per decade).

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the newest sample of the selected hosts' engines. A few seconds: the processes are reporting, and a chart at zero means no traffic. Growing, or no data: nothing is reporting (the load ended, or the scrape or the push broke), and the charts say nothing about the traffic.

panels.title: $mhost: GPU to GPU, rate (sender -> receiver), average over $window
panels.description: Bytes per second between the GPUs of this host. A cell is the rate and its direction: "48.5 GB/s (4 -> 5)" is what GPU 4 sent to GPU 5 (cpu = host memory). The row is the sender, the column the receiver. Stronger blue: 10 GB/s and more; weaker: 1 to 10 GB/s; faint: less. One matrix for every selected host that moves data between its own GPUs; traffic between two hosts is in the charts below, not here.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (src_gpu, dst_gpu) ("rate", round((sum by (src_gpu, dst_gpu) ((rate(mori_io_completed_bytes_total{src_host="${mhost:raw}",dst_host="${mhost:raw}",backend=~"$backend",backend!~"xgmi|fabric"}[$window]) or rate(mori_io_submitted_bytes_total{src_host="${mhost:raw}",dst_host="${mhost:raw}",backend=~"$backend",backend=~"xgmi|fabric"}[$window]))) >= 1e9) / 1e8)), "rate", "0.$1", "rate", "(\\d)"), "rate", "$1.$2", "rate", "(\\d+)(\\d)"), "unit", "GB/s", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (src_gpu, dst_gpu) ("rate", round((sum by (src_gpu, dst_gpu) ((rate(mori_io_completed_bytes_total{src_host="${mhost:raw}",dst_host="${mhost:raw}",backend=~"$backend",backend!~"xgmi|fabric"}[$window]) or rate(mori_io_submitted_bytes_total{src_host="${mhost:raw}",dst_host="${mhost:raw}",backend=~"$backend",backend=~"xgmi|fabric"}[$window]))) < 1e9 >= 5e4) / 1e5)), "rate", "0.$1", "rate", "(\\d)"), "rate", "$1.$2", "rate", "(\\d+)(\\d)"), "unit", "MB/s", "", ""), "tmp", "|", "rate", "unit", "src_gpu", "dst_gpu"), "cell", "$1 $2 ($3 -> $4)", "tmp", "(.*)\\|(.*)\\|(.*)\\|(.*)")

panels.title: Sent per GPU over $backend
panels.description: Bytes per second leaving each GPU of the selected hosts through this backend (the source of a write, or of a read's data). xgmi: over the links between the GPUs of a host. rdma: through the GPU's NIC, the same bytes the NIC row shows, with the NIC's link speed as a dashed line. A GPU has the same colour in every chart. Whichever engine started the transfer.

panels.title: Received per GPU over $backend
panels.description: Bytes per second arriving at each GPU of the selected hosts through this backend. Whichever engine started the transfer.

panels.title: Sent per NIC
panels.description: Bytes per second of the RDMA data work requests, by the NIC of the selected hosts that sent them: the rdma backend only, xgmi traffic never touches a NIC. Recorded by the initiator with both ends, so a NIC's line adds up what every engine sent through it. This is the number to hold against the NIC's own transmit counter. Dashed: the link speed the system reports; a NIC has the colour of the GPU with the same index.

panels.title: Received per NIC
panels.description: Bytes per second of the RDMA data work requests, by the NIC of the selected hosts that received them.
